name: HOI robustness benchmark
description: Human-Object Interaction (HOI) detection has seen substantial advances in recent years. However, existing works focus on the standard setting with ideal images and natural distribution, far from practical scenarios with inevitable distribution shifts. This hampers the practical applicability of HOI detection. In this work, we investigate this issue by benchmarking, analyzing, and enhancing the robustness of HOI detection models under various distribution shifts. We start by proposing a novel automated approach to create the first robustness evaluation benchmark for HOI detection. Subsequently, we evaluate more than 40 existing HOI detection models on this benchmark, showing their insufficiency, analyzing the features of different frameworks, and discussing how the robustness in HOI is different from other tasks. reputation: A very recent robustness benchmark for HOI detection that is primarily of research interest within the HOI and robustness communities.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; robustness under distribution shift is the focus, so scores vary by corruption/domain shift setting and are not directly comparable to standard HOI benchmarks.
